newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-NatMut year net above forecast.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-NatMut year net above forecast.

text.p: Superannuation and insurance group National Mutual Holdings Ltd said on Tuesday its net profit for the year to September 30 was above its prospectus forecast and showed an emerging improvement in performance.

"The profit outcome, together with healthy new business volumes, an 11 percent drop in expenses, and improved investment earnings, reflects a clear emergence of an improvement in the National Mutual Life Group's peformance," National Mutual said.
Earlier National Mutual reported a A$210.88 million net profit for the year, above the A$198 million forecast in its July share offer document.

The 1995/96 result compared with the A$115.5 million profit posted in 1994/95. National Mutual Managing Director Geoff Tomlinson said in a statement with the results that National Mutual's subsidiary companies saw solid performances.

National Mutual Asia, which is 56 percent owned by National Mutual Holdings, contributed A$99.2 million to the profit result, up 36.3 percent on the previous year. French Insurance group AXA SA owns 51 percent of National Mutual.

"Asia continues to provide many opportunities," Tomlinson said. "We are working hard to improve our chances of getting a licence to operate in China, an application for entry into Thailand has been made and we have increased our research activity in India, the Philippines and Vietnam," he said.
National Mutual Funds Management achieved a A$17.9 million improvement in profit for the year.
Shareholders' funds rose to A$2.945 billion as at September 30 from A$2.744 billion as at March 31.
National Mutual declared a four cent final dividend.
